'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Jake Nelson LS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
